fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects possible collection of data from the clipboard via execution of the osascript binary
fields.name: Clipboard Data Collection Via OSAScript
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="osx" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "osascript" and tgt.process.cmdline contains " -e " and tgt.process.cmdline contains "clipboard"))
